mil3.1.7:1.2: “Venerable Nagasena, the one who does not recollect—is it not by rational application of mind that he does not recollect?”
mil3.1.7:1.3: “By rational application of mind and wisdom and other skillful qualities, Great King.”
mil3.1.7:1.4: “But, venerable sir, is rational application of mind alone wisdom?”
mil3.1.7:1.5: “No, Great King. Another rational application of mind, another wisdom—but, Great King, even goats, cows, buffaloes, camels, and horses have a rational application of mind, yet they have no wisdom.”
mil3.1.7:3.1: The Question on Proper Attention: Seventh.
